scenes.text: 1968, a symbol, a threat, a killer’s last cipher

description: The Zodiac Killer’s last cryptogram, sent in 1968, contained 32 enigmatic characters that the San Francisco Police Department never cracked. The unsolved cipher continues to intrigue cryptographers and crime enthusiasts alike. Follow for more cold‑case chronicles.
